summary: The note announces a series of Wellness Workshops on preventative health, screenings and check-ups, organized by the Local Health and Wellness Initiative and held at the Leafy Greens Community Center. Sessions cover heart health, children's screenings, technology, mental health and nutrition, with different speakers for each. The goal is to make preventive health information accessible and shift the community from reactive to proactive care.
one_line: Wellness Workshops at the Leafy Greens Community Center promote preventative health screenings and check-ups through expert-led sessions on heart, child, mental, nutritional and tech topics.
key_facts: The Wellness Workshops on Preventative Health: Screenings and Check-Ups for Lifelong Wellness are set to commence on September 5, 2023, per the introduction.
The workshops are organized by the Local Health and Wellness Initiative and held at the Leafy Greens Community Center.
The note also says the workshops are spread across several weekends, from September 15, 2023 to October 30, 2023.
Keynote speaker Dr. Linda Carter, a preventive medicine specialist, says annual health screenings and regular check-ups should be integrated into our lifestyles.
Topics include blood pressure and cholesterol checks, diabetes screenings, cancer screenings (mammograms and colonoscopies), and dental and eye exams.
Sessions are tailored to working adults, seniors and children.
Cardiologist Dr. John McKenzie will speak about heart health, saying "Knowledge is the first step toward prevention."
Sunnydale Clinic nurses will give guidance on navigating healthcare systems and health insurance; Nurse Practitioner Emily Brown says "We want to demystify the process."
Pediatrician Dr. Alex Torres leads a session on pediatric health screenings and lifestyle habits on October 12, 2023.
Health tech expert Sandra Lee leads a workshop on wearables, health apps and telemedicine on October 22, 2023.
Psychologist Dr. Rajiv Desai speaks on mental health check-ups on September 25, 2023.
Dietician Maria Gonzales discusses nutritional science and debunks myths on September 20, 2023.
A central goal is spreading preventive health information widely, breaking down barriers of language and socio-economic status.
